verdict.rationale: Cline's CLI shows an example of referencing a screenshot image (`@./screenshot.png`) to fix a UI issue, indicating some multimodal image-input capability, but there is no documented workflow for generating a full working app from a sketch, image, or PDF design. Missing for 10: explicit PDF/design-file ingestion, end-to-end 'sketch-to-app' generation workflow, and any hands-on/community confirmation of this specific capability.
